claims: NASA's Artemis 2 is scheduled to launch no earlier than April 1, 2026.
Artemis 2 is a 10-day crewed flight test.
Artemis 2 carries four astronauts: Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis 2 carries its crew around the Moon and back.
Artemis 2 uses the SLS rocket.
Artemis 2 uses the Orion capsule.
Artemis 2 tests systems for future lunar landings.
The Artemis 2 crew will fly 4,600 miles beyond the far side of the Moon.
4,600 miles beyond the far side of the Moon is further than any human has traveled.
Artemis 2 sets a new spaceflight record.
The SLS rocket launches from Kennedy Space Center's Pad 39B.
The SLS rocket lifts the crew in the Orion spacecraft.
Orion separates from the SLS upper stage.
Orion uses its own engines to begin a four-day journey to the Moon.
The Artemis 2 crew performs a free-return trajectory around the Moon.
The Artemis 2 crew tests life support systems.
The Artemis 2 crew tests navigation.
The Artemis 2 crew tests manual piloting of the Orion capsule.
Artemis 2 concludes with a re-entry at 25,000 mph into Earth's atmosphere.
Artemis 2 tests the heat shield.
Artemis 2 splashes down in the Pacific Ocean.
Reid Wiseman is a NASA astronaut.
Victor Glover is a NASA astronaut.
Christina Koch is a NASA astronaut.
Jeremy Hansen is a CSA astronaut.
Artemis 2 is the first human flight to the vicinity of the Moon in over 50 years.
Artemis 2 features the first woman to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
Artemis 2 features the first person of color to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
Artemis 2 features the first Canadian to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
Artemis 2 prepares for future Artemis missions that will land the first woman and person of color on the Moon in 2028.
